statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2024-0384 is an informational notice that the instant crate is unmaintained. It names no vulnerability and no patched release. instant 0.1.13 is compiled into libflux through parking_lot 0.11.2 and parking_lot_core 0.8.6, which flux-core takes through the salsa crate. Replacing it needs a change in flux, the Flux query engine that Kapacitor links as libflux.

RUSTSEC-2024-0384 is an informational notice that the instant crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus 2.6.23 includes it through measure_time in the legacy Tantivy fork used for V5 index compatibility; migrating that fork to std::time remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2024-0384.html
